title: Storybound script block
description: config/storybound/scripts/<path>.json — a script block of the dev mode's story canvas: a KubeJS handler the story calls (the action or condition "Script" with its id), the file it is written in and what it leads to. The code stays in KubeJS; the game never reads script blocks. Optional: every handler the scripts register shows on the canvas anyway; a block adds a title, a description and leads_to (also writable in the script as // @storybound leads_to quest:ns:id).

description.description: A note for the pack's authors: what the script does.

file.description: The script, under kubejs/server_scripts/ on the server, e.g. storybound/mypack/burn_village.js.

hook.description: The handler's id, as registered with StoryboundEvents.registerActions / registerConditions. The block's own id when absent.

leads_to.description: What the script goes on to (a quest it starts, a dialogue it opens), for what reading its file does not show.
